name: lochinbekdev-security
description: Small, composable security-audit skills for backends: an orchestrator plus focused skills for authorization, API surface, uploads, dependencies and service trust boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Six read-only security skills that audit an authorized backend and produce one reproducible report: a backend orchestrator plus focused skills for access control, API surface, file uploads, dependency supply chain, and microservice trust boundaries. Every skill grills for scope before it touches a live system, writes nothing but the report, and marks any finding it could not confirm at runtime.
